description: This Java class provides miscellaneous utility methods for handling Android MIDI devices, specifically including a method to find a MIDI device matching given manufacturer and product criteria.

classes.name: MidiTools
classes.description: Utility class for Android MIDI device management, including device lookup based on manufacturer and product info.

methods.name: findDevice
methods.description: Searches through available MIDI devices managed by the provided MidiManager to find one matching the specified manufacturer and product strings. Returns the matching MidiDeviceInfo or null if none is found.
